title: Sequencing trap that turned out to be a false alarm but reads as a real threat: getting the gray priest's blessing to open the barrow doors, then promising the reeve to seal them, prompted the innkeep to warn 'his blessing opens the doors — but not for anyone who promised the reeve to shut them.' In practice the doors were already open and sealing them afterward worked with no penalty or contradiction shown at the throne. The warning implies a broken/blocked outcome that never materializes, which is confusing regardless of order chosen.
where: The Last Light Inn / ask innkeep: the reeve and the priest
